info.name: CosmicForge Real Estate
info.description: Official human-facing API handoff collection for CosmicForge Real Estate. OpenAPI remains the machine-readable contract. Requests are added only when the matching backend endpoint is implemented.

item.name: 00 Platform
item.description: Gateway/platform health, readiness and version endpoints. Edge behaviour common to all APIs: errors use the platform envelope (see examples), X-Request-ID is echoed, 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED / INVALID_TOKEN, 403 PERMISSION_DENIED for a token from another product, 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After, 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND (including any /internal path).

request.description: Liveness of the API Gateway. No authentication.
Readiness of the API Gateway; 503 while draining for shutdown.
Build metadata of the deployed gateway image.

item.name: 01 Marketplace
item.description: Frontend-facing Marketplace APIs.

item.name: 02 Individual Owner
item.description: Individual Owner (individual-owner-service). Frontend requests go through the gateway with {{individual_owner_token}}; _Internal and _Admin requests call the service directly with a service JWT ({{service_token}}). Implemented: Section 5 account security (Frontend, _Admin) and the Sections 6–13 domain API generated from the route registry (profile, banking & tax, properties, ownership & verification and later contexts). Features whose dependency is not configured answer 503 FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE. Runtime integrations remain unavailable unless implemented and independently certified: real CF Meet, e-sign, external calendar/listing sync, physical smart devices, maps/geocoding, licensed financing/insurance and future Marketplace/Manager/Artisan/Professional services. Financial Core contracts do not approve custody, escrow, DVA or transfers.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = body.data; const tokens = d.tokens || d; if (tokens.access_token) pm.environment.set("business_access_token", tokens.access_token); if (tokens.refresh_token) pm.environment.set("business_refresh_token", tokens.refresh_token); for (const k of ["account_id","organisation_id","session_id","device_id","method_id","role_id","staff_id","invitation_id","capacity_id","capability_pack_id","delegation_id","break_glass_id","mfa_token","verification_id","handover_id","import_id","mapping_id","media_link_id","space_graph_id"]) if (d[k]) pm.environment.set("business_"+k,d[k]); if (d.handover_id) pm.environment.set("business_handover_id",d.handover_id); if (d.id) pm.environment.set("business_id",d.id); if (d.approval) pm.environment.set("business_approval_id",d.approval.approval_id || d.approval.id); if (d.policy) pm.environment.set("business_policy_id",d.policy.policy_id || d.policy.id); if (d.version) pm.environment.set("business_version",d.version); }

Bounded room configuration needs exact independent COMMERCIAL_PMS_ACCESS_CONFIGURATION approval; DISABLED never falls back to an older policy. Keys/cards require actual qualified manual handover/return evidence. A browser cannot assert smart-device delivery. Authenticated adapter observations bind original tenant/device/window/digest and idempotency key; timeouts remain UNKNOWN and recovery reads back the original command. Checkout, room move, configuration changes, current authority loss and expiry revoke the original grant; pending revocation never claims current active access. No credential code, password or provider secret belongs in these APIs. No live smart-device provider is registered by default. Physical rooms come from canonical stock. Check-in rechecks identity/readiness/risk/financial backing. Inspection requires room_status:inspect and recent MFA. Folio views additionally require folios:read. Independent exact approvals cover early arrival, compensating corrections and debt departure; guarantees never represent collected money. Device outcomes remain UNKNOWN without authenticated provider confirmation.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = body.data; const tokens = d.tokens || d; if (tokens.access_token) pm.environment.set("business_access_token", tokens.access_token); if (tokens.refresh_token) pm.environment.set("business_refresh_token", tokens.refresh_token); for (const k of ["account_id","organisation_id","session_id","device_id","method_id","role_id","staff_id","invitation_id","capacity_id","capability_pack_id","delegation_id","break_glass_id","mfa_token","verification_id","handover_id","import_id","mapping_id","media_link_id","space_graph_id"]) if (d[k]) pm.environment.set("business_"+k,d[k]); if (d.handover_id) pm.environment.set("business_handover_id",d.handover_id); if (d.id) pm.environment.set("business_id",d.id); if (d.approval) pm.environment.set("business_approval_id",d.approval.approval_id || d.approval.id); if (d.policy) pm.environment.set("business_policy_id",d.policy.policy_id || d.policy.id); if (d.version) pm.environment.set("business_version",d.version); }

request.description: Authentication: business access JWT plus live account/session. Permission: reservations:cancel. Scope: trusted organisation and resolved resource hierarchy. Idempotency-Key is required; replay returns the original committed result, changed payload conflicts. Trusted live tenant/membership and property scope; current versions and immutable history. Side-effect retries require Idempotency-Key. Quantity-level changes apply to a confirmed or in-house line whose every accepted night is committed at exactly the line quantity, with no physical assignment, stay, group block, rooming entry, outstanding overbooking or unresolved collection. The highest-numbered slots are detached or cancelled so every remaining slot keeps its frozen amount; accepted lines are superseded, never edited. An immutable ledger records per date original = remaining + transferred + released committed quantity and the conserved amount/accommodation split. Partial cancellation releases stock and records a frozen-policy PARTIAL_CANCELLED obligation; refunds stay pending Payment readback. Split and merge need recent MFA and an exact independent COMMERCIAL_RESERVATION_LINEAGE approval bound to the moved amount; merges are limited to one split family and one source contract/provider.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d = body.data; const tokens = d.tokens || d; if (tokens.access_token) pm.environment.set("business_access_token", tokens.access_token); if (tokens.refresh_token) pm.environment.set("business_refresh_token", tokens.refresh_token); for (const k of ["account_id","organisation_id","session_id","device_id","method_id","role_id","staff_id","invitation_id","capacity_id","capability_pack_id","delegation_id","break_glass_id","mfa_token","verification_id","handover_id","import_id","mapping_id","media_link_id","space_graph_id"]) if (d[k]) pm.environment.set("business_"+k,d[k]); if (d.handover_id) pm.environment.set("business_handover_id",d.handover_id); if (d.id) pm.environment.set("business_id",d.id); if (d.approval) pm.environment.set("business_approval_id",d.approval.approval_id || d.approval.id); if (d.policy) pm.environment.set("business_policy_id",d.policy.policy_id || d.policy.id); if (d.version) pm.environment.set("business_version",d.version); }

request.description: Authentication: business access JWT plus live account/session. Permission: recovery:read. Scope: trusted organisation and resolved resource hierarchy. Optimistic version, token single-use or documented provider key protects applicable retries. Trusted live tenant/membership and property scope; current versions and immutable history. Cases follow OPEN, ASSIGNED, INVESTIGATING, REMEDY_PROPOSED, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, EXECUTION_PENDING, RESOLVED, CLOSED with REJECTED, ESCALATED, CANCELLED and REOPEN paths. Monetary or points remedies need recent MFA and an exact independent COMMERCIAL_SERVICE_RECOVERY_REMEDY approval bound to the remedy digest, amount and currency; non-monetary remedies need a distinct approver. Refund, financial adjustment and booking-credit requests stay PENDING_EXTERNAL_CONTRACT because Payment remedies are Admin-authorized; a case resolves only after every approved remedy has a verified outcome or a recorded guest decline. Inventory reconciliation never closes guest recovery. Guest/corporate records are property-scoped; contact/accessibility fields use protected storage and purpose-specific capabilities/current consent. Source identity links require authenticated evidence and exact independent approval. Marketplace accounts and Payment financial outcomes remain externally owned.
